company.shortDescription: Guggy helps you make your friends laugh by turning your text messages into engaging content, such as personalized GIFs.
company.description:
Guggy helps you make your friends laugh by turning your text messages into funny personalized GIFs.

It works like this: whenever you want to spice up your conversation just click on Guggy's button and you'll get a selection of funny and creative GIFs that were specially made for you.

That way, your basic, dry conversation becomes far more fun and expressive.

Guggy is available on iOS, Android, and as a WebApp! You can use it here (Free!) https://goo.gl/PVbepk

Learn more about Guggy at https://guggy.com/
